helpdesk__list_employees.description: Retrieve all employees from the database. Returns a list of employee records with all fields.

helpdesk__get_employee.description: Fetch a single employee by ID. Returns the employee record or raises a 404 error if not found.

helpdesk__list_tickets.description: Retrieve tickets with optional filtering by status (including 'unresolved' for non-resolved tickets), severity, or asset_id. Returns matching ticket records.

helpdesk__get_ticket.description: Fetch a single ticket by ID. Returns the ticket record or raises a 404 error if not found.

helpdesk__escalate_ticket.description: Mark a ticket as high severity and in-progress status. Requires a valid ticket ID and returns success confirmation or 404 if ticket not found.

assets__list_assets.description: Retrieve all assets from the database, optionally filtered by type and/or criticality level. Returns a list of asset records.

assets__get_asset.description: Fetch a single asset by its ID. Returns the asset record or raises a 404 error if the asset does not exist.

assets__create_replacement_request.description: Create a new replacement request for an asset by providing the asset ID and a reason. Returns the newly created request ID.
